title: Crosswalk integration standup brief — 2027-11-17
content:
Attendees: Avery (owner), Samir (field eng), Lucia (solutions), Ravi (SRE contact), Maya (customer success), plus reps from Veridian (J. Alvarez) and LuminaAI (T. Park).

Purpose: Weekly cross-team sync to surface customer integration status, escalate infra or product risks, and align on short-term rollout windows. This doc is intended to be terse — highlights, blocking items, and concrete actions.

1) Veridian Health — staging -> canary prep
Status: On track for canary beginning 2027-11-24, but uncovered two infra regressions during scale tests (higher tail latency on model shard rebalancing).
Recent work: Lucia pushed updated prompt routing for fallback variants; Ravi implemented a temporary KV-cache bypass to isolate latency source.
Blockers: SRE needs a hotfix to the shard rebalance timeout (SRE-451) — currently causing 500s under concurrent reconnects. Veridian requests SLA for canary window.
Risks: If hotfix not in place by 2027-11-22, canary must shift or use reduced concurrency profile (affects cost/throughput metrics).
Decisions: Short-term rollback plan approved — if hotfix incomplete, run canary at 25% traffic with aggressive autoscaling.
Actions:
- Ravi to cut hotfix branch and open PR by EOD 2027-11-18 (GH PR: /pull/6421).
- Samir to coordinate Veridian canary kickoff and confirm MTR (maintenance) window with their infra team by 2027-11-19.
- Lucia to prepare prompt-set smoke tests and provide 3 failing/passing examples to customer success by 2027-11-20.
Owners: Ravi (hotfix), Samir (customer coordination), Lucia (smoke tests).

2) LuminaAI — private deployment pilot
Status: Pilot bootstrap completed; initial model upload succeeded but we hit KMS policy mismatch during key rotation test.
Recent work: Maya validated onboarding docs; engineering ran a dry-run of the private-control-plane install in staging.
Blockers: KMS policy for rotation isn't permitting the control plane to retrieve wrapped keys under the customer's HSM alias — requires policy tweak and reassessment of key access lifecycle.
Risks: Audit window for Lumina requires rotation proof by 2027-11-30. Failure will delay go-live.
Actions:
- Avery to draft KMS policy change and share with Lumina security by 2027-11-18.
- Ravi to run a simulated rotation and provide logs for Lumina's auditors by 2027-11-19.
- Solutions to document fallback flow (customer-managed key vs Redwood-managed) in runbook by 2027-11-21.
Owners: Avery (policy draft), Ravi (sim rotation), Lucia (runbook update).

3) Tidewater (pilot ramp) — observations and quality regressions
Status: Ramped to 40% traffic; quality monitoring flagged tokenization mismatch in long-context prompts producing truncated customer system messages.
Recent work: Team reproduced on a smaller test set; cause traced to tokenizer mismatch between model variant and ingest pipeline.
Blockers: Need a short patch to normalize incoming prompt encoding in the gateway (minor change, low-risk).
Actions:
- Samir to schedule a 1-hr deploy window 2027-11-20 02:00-03:00 UTC for the gateway patch.
- Lucia to run acceptance QA on 500 long-context prompts and publish report to Confluence by 2027-11-20.
Owners: Samir (deploy), Lucia (QA).

Cross-customer notes / platform observations
- Autoscaling: Observed uneven GPU utilization across Dedicated pools during mixed small/large-sequence workloads. Suggested experiment: enable per-route sequence-length binning for 48 hours to validate throughput gains.
- Caching: KV prefix cache TTL tuning for multi-tenant bursts looks promising — initial back-of-envelope suggests 8–12% token-cost reduction for chat-heavy workloads. Lucia to run a controlled A/B next week.
- Rollout tooling: Need a small enhancement to rollout UI to show per-variant tail-latency (requested by Veridian). Product ticket created INTG-1423.

Open risks / escalations
- SRE-451 (shard rebalance timeout) is P0 for Veridian canary. If unresolved, will require capacity fencing or canary delay.
- KMS rotation proof for Lumina is a compliance blocker; escalate to platform security if logs not delivered by 2027-11-19.

Decisions made during this sync
- Canary fallback policy approved: run canary at reduced concurrency if hotfix is delayed; notify customers 24h in advance.
- Approve experimental per-route binning for Dedicated pools for 48h (engineering to measure CPU/GPU balance).

Action item tracker (short):
- PROSERV-987: Veridian canary runbook completion — Samir — due 2027-11-19.
- SRE-451: Shard rebalance hotfix — Ravi — PR by 2027-11-18, target merge 2027-11-19.
- INTG-1423: Rollout UI latency metric — Product assigned, spec due 2027-11-26.
- KMS-rot: Lumina rotation proof logs — Ravi & Avery — due 2027-11-19.
- Runbook update: Private deploy fallback flow — Lucia — due 2027-11-21.

Notes to self / follow-ups
- Prep a short customer-facing one-pager for Veridian that outlines the canary contingency plan and expected metrics to be tracked (latency p50/p95/p99, error rate, token cost delta). Samir to draft.
- Flag potential postmortem if SRE-451 not closed by 2027-11-23.

Meeting cadence: continue weekly sync Tuesdays 16:00 UTC. If any P0 appears, spin up an immediate warroom.

Attachments / referenced artifacts: PR /pull/6421 (hotfix branch), PROSERV-987 (runbook), INTG-1423 (product request), confluence:cx/veridian-integration-runbook.

End of notes.
